title: Kissed Gooey Venezuelan Lemongrass Chicken Skewers
description: A charred and gooey Venezuelan dish featuring lemongrass stalks and stir-fry, this recipe is kosher-friendly and perfect for a romantic evening.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, soy sauce, honey, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken and lemongrass pieces onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through and slightly charred.
While the skewers are grilling, prepare the stir-fry by heating a tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped cilantro to the skillet and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Serve the grilled skewers on top of the cilantro stir-fry, garnished with additional lemongrass pieces if desired.
